services.body: We assess demand, audience fit and the information buyers need before enquiring. The plan sets out channel roles, launch requirements and review criteria, including what needs to be fixed on the website or tracking first.
services.fit: Businesses choosing where to advertise or reconsidering ads that are not working.
deliverables: Review of your customers and offer
Recommendations for suitable platforms and budgets
What your ads and website need before testing
A plan for reviewing results and deciding what to do next
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
services.inputs: Customer locations, offer and pricing details, existing results and the budget available for tests.
services.measure: We review what each test can tell you about useful enquiries and spending.

faq.q: Will the strategy include campaign management?
faq.a: The strategy defines the plan and priorities. Campaign setup and ongoing management can be scoped separately or included in an agreed combined engagement.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for performance marketing strategy services?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

services.metaDescription: Choose suitable paid channels, define the offer and agree launch requirements, budgets and review criteria.

services.name: Social Media Marketing Strategy
services.headline: Give your social media a clear purpose.
services.summary: Posting on social media without a clear plan?
services.body: We connect your offer and customer questions with suitable content formats. The plan explains what to publish, which next actions to include and how organic social differs from paid advertising.
services.fit: For businesses starting social media or posting without a clear direction.
deliverables: Review of your current social profiles
Recommended platforms based on your customers
Post topics that explain your services and answer questions
An agreed posting schedule and sample ideas
Recommendations for profile links and contact options
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
services.inputs: Share your social profile links, products or services, customer locations and available photos. Tell us what you want people to do after seeing a post.

faq.q: Does social media marketing include paid ads?

faq.q: How do I get a quote for social media marketing strategy?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

services.metaDescription: Plan social platforms, content themes and next steps around your offer and real customer questions.

services.summary: Need useful social posts without doing everything yourself?
services.body: We build the content plan around your offer, useful advice and approved business information. Drafts, revisions and posting schedules are agreed in advance. Reporting reviews meaningful engagement and available website or enquiry activity.

deliverables: An agreed monthly content calendar
Post copy and designs for the agreed formats
Your review and approval before publishing
Scheduling or publishing where agreed access allows it
